policy: Only named methods with a primary paper and reviewed conventional benchmark adaptations. Public papers/preprints count as paper-backed and are labelled honestly. Custom local architectures, novel composite objectives and research variants are excluded even when inspired by a published family. A paper link does not claim reproduction of its reported results. Unknown future runs fail closed until explicitly reviewed.

review_notes.historical_baselines: HAT-L original capacity with conventional L1/Charbonnier/LPIPS losses and bounded training-length changes retained. HAT-XL is custom scaling and excluded. Palette epsilon/reference retained; gamma/velocity variants excluded. I2I-Mamba direct published backbone adaptation retained; marker-fusion variants excluded. STABLE channels corrected to input/target widths while native objectives retained.
review_notes.research_exclusion_reason: These upstream papers exist, but the current local runs are substantial independent research adaptations, not conventional published benchmark model recipes. Do not describe upstream methods themselves as unpublished.
review_notes.her2match_20261123: Canonical HER2Match campaign configs and disclosed native budget continuations reviewed; strict actual source/config/manifest/tensor-update/resume gates bind training evidence. BCIStainer remains unscored and blocked without genuine tile grades. All87 original unpublished recipes stay excluded.
review_notes.dgr_rgb_rescue_20261123: Separate fresh seed42 numerical rescue after source-verified colour collapse; unchanged six original DGR model/vendor files, original RGB author1e-5FP32 preset, native per-network0.5gradient clipping, constantLR and full-validation patience. Mandatory104-step four-rank resumed G/RegGT/RegX/D learned-weight and optimizer proof. Old failure and scores remain visible; no test selection or claimed repair success from submission.
review_notes.mcs_fp32_recovery_20261123: Historical fresh seed42 repair attempt restored FP32 and G-first/D-second order but still failed the constant-white-output gate before production. Later author-code audit identified semantic Cellpose BatchNorm-mode and adversarial scale-reduction discrepancies that this attempt did not correct. Its original source, failure and earlier poor full evaluation remain preserved. Separate short author-contract diagnostic controls are private and unranked; no successful repair claim follows from source changes or submission.
review_notes.architecture_expansion_20261123: Published Pix2PixHD (CVPR2018), Uformer-B (CVPR2022), DCLGAN (CVPRW/NTIRE2021), and I2SB (ICML2023) are conventional RGB staining adaptations on frozen HER2Match and BCI HER2 fields. Full native author capacities and defining objectives are retained; actual four-GPU positive-LR learned-update/resume proofs and nine-field independent validation are mandatory. DCL requires both G/D/projection directions and three optimizers; I2SB requires online+EMA updates and verified initialization; Pix2PixHD requires fixed verified VGG19. Queued or merely registered recipes carry no invented score. Diagnostic controls and additional variants are not approved implicitly.
